After the joint training session, Happy 
Meek and Trainer Kiryuin proposed a match 
between the two.

Since any discipline is fair game... I've 
decided to make my choice without holding 
back!

A speed showdown against Happy Meek 
begins...!

A stamina showdown against Happy Meek 
begins...!

A power showdown against Happy Meek 
begins...!

A contest of grit against Happy Meek 
begins...!

A contest of wits against Happy Meek 
begins...!

A physical endurance contest against Happy 
Meek begins...!

—A magnificent victory! <chrname> looked satisfied, 
while Happy Meek and the others fired 
themselves up.

—A magnificent victory! <chrname> looked completely 
satisfied, while Happy Meek and the others 
vowed to take their revenge.

Happy Meek and the others were so 
strong...! <chrname> slumps her shoulders... She 
wants to do her best so she can win next 
time!
